WITH all_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    totals.transactions as txn,
    device.deviceCategory as dev_cat,
    visitStartTime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
),
transaction_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    dev_cat,
    visitStartTime,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date, visitStartTime) as rn
  FROM all_sessions
  WHERE txn IS NOT NULL
),
first_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date as first_transaction_date,
    dev_cat as transaction_device
  FROM transaction_sessions
  WHERE rn = 1
),
first_visits AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM all_sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
)
SELECT 
  ft.fullVisitorId,
  fvd.first_visit_date,
  ft.first_transaction_date,
  DATE_DIFF(
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ft.first_transaction_date), 
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fvd.first_visit_date), 
    DAY
  ) as days_elapsed,
  ft.transaction_device
FROM first_transactions ft
JOIN first_visits fvd ON ft.fullVisitorId = fvd.fullVisitorId
ORDER BY ft.fullVisitorId

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date, SUM(h.product[OFFSET(0)].productRevenue) / 1000000.0 as daily_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
    AND ARRAY_LENGTH(h.product) > 0
    AND h.product[OFFSET(0)].productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY date
),
max_daily AS (
  SELECT MAX(daily_rev) as max_daily_millions FROM daily
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT CAST(DATE_DIFF(CAST(CONCAT(SUBSTR(date, 1, 4), '-', SUBSTR(date, 5, 2), '-', SUBSTR(date, 7, 2)) AS DATE), DATE('2017-01-01'), DAY) / 7 AS INT64) as week_num,
    SUM(daily_rev) as weekly_total
  FROM daily
  GROUP BY week_num
),
max_weekly AS (
  SELECT MAX(weekly_total) as max_weekly_millions FROM weekly
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT SUBSTR(date, 1, 6) as month_key, SUM(daily_rev) as monthly_total
  FROM daily
  GROUP BY month_key
),
max_monthly AS (
  SELECT MAX(monthly_total) as max_monthly_millions FROM monthly
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' as traffic_source,
  (SELECT max_daily_millions FROM max_daily) as max_daily_millions,
  (SELECT max_weekly_millions FROM max_weekly) as max_weekly_millions,
  (SELECT max_monthly_millions FROM max_monthly) as max_monthly_millions

WITH session_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    date,
    totals.pageviews,
    totals.transactions,
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, visitId, date, totals.pageviews, totals.transactions
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    date,
    pageviews,
    transactions,
    has_product_revenue,
    CASE 
      WHEN transactions >= 1 AND has_product_revenue = 1 THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN transactions IS NULL AND has_product_revenue = 0 THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS session_type
  FROM session_revenue
)
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month,
  session_type,
  ROUND(AVG(pageviews), 2) AS avg_pageviews
FROM classified
WHERE session_type IN ('purchase', 'non-purchase')
GROUP BY month, session_type
ORDER BY month, session_type

-- Final query: Find the distinct product with highest total quantity purchased by visitors who also bought YouTube products
WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE LOWER(p.v2ProductName) LIKE '%youtube%'
    AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
),
visitor_products AS (
  SELECT t.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE t.fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM youtube_buyers)
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
  GROUP BY t.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName
)
SELECT v2ProductName, total_quantity
FROM visitor_products
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_incidents.incidents_2016`
  WHERE descript = 'PUBLIC INTOXICATION'
  GROUP BY date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(daily_count) as mean_count,
    STDDEV(daily_count) as stddev_count
  FROM daily_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.date,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) as z_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_counts dc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', date) as date
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 2

WITH page_hits AS (
  SELECT 
    t.fullVisitorId,
    t.visitId,
    h.hitNumber,
    h.page.pagePath,
    h.time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.fullVisitorId, t.visitId ORDER BY h.hitNumber) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX LIKE '201701%'
  AND LOWER(t.trafficSource.campaign) LIKE '%data share%'
  AND h.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_with_next AS (
  SELECT 
    ph.pagePath AS home_page,
    ph.time AS home_time,
    ph.fullVisitorId,
    ph.visitId,
    ph.hitNumber,
    ph.rn,
    LEAD(ph.pagePath) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.fullVisitorId, ph.visitId ORDER BY ph.hitNumber) AS next_page_path,
    LEAD(ph.time) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.fullVisitorId, ph.visitId ORDER BY ph.hitNumber) AS next_time
  FROM page_hits ph
),
home_hits AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM home_with_next
  WHERE home_page = '/home'
),
time_spent AS (
  SELECT 
    home_page,
    next_page_path,
    SAFE_DIVIDE((next_time - home_time), 1000) AS time_seconds
  FROM home_hits
  WHERE next_page_path IS NOT NULL
),
next_page_counts AS (
  SELECT next_page_path, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM time_spent
  GROUP BY next_page_path
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT MAX(time_seconds) AS max_time_seconds
  FROM time_spent
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT next_page_path FROM next_page_counts ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1) AS most_common_next_page,
  CAST(max_time_seconds AS INT64) AS max_time_seconds
FROM max_time

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) / 1000000.0 as monthly_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY month
),
max_min AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(monthly_revenue_millions) as max_monthly,
    MIN(monthly_revenue_millions) as min_monthly
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' as traffic_source,
  ROUND((max_monthly - min_monthly), 2) as difference_millions
FROM max_min

SELECT 
  p.v2ProductName,
  SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
UNNEST(hits) AS h,
UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
AND fullVisitorId IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h2
    WHERE EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(h2.product) AS p2
      WHERE p2.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
    )
  )
)
AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
AND p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH 
users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
),
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE u7.user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM users_2day)

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0
    AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-04-30'
),
growth AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    prev_new_confirmed,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) AS growth_rate
  FROM daily
  WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL AND prev_new_confirmed > 0
)
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) AS day
FROM growth
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT provider_city,
       SUM(total_discharges) as total_discharges,
       SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) as weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
  AND provider_city IN ('NEW YORK', 'BOSTON', 'SPRINGFIELD')
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY total_discharges DESC

WITH top20_routes AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_name,
    end_station_name,
    ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3) as r_start_lat,
    ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3) as r_start_lon,
    ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3) as r_end_lat,
    ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3) as r_end_lon,
    AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
  GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
taxi_matches AS (
  SELECT 
    r.start_station_name,
    r.end_station_name,
    r.avg_bike_duration,
    AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
  FROM top20_routes r
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
    ON ROUND(t.pickup_latitude, 3) = r.r_start_lat
    AND ROUND(t.pickup_longitude, 3) = r.r_start_lon
    AND ROUND(t.dropoff_latitude, 3) = r.r_end_lat
    AND ROUND(t.dropoff_longitude, 3) = r.r_end_lon
  WHERE t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL AND t.dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL AND t.dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.trip_distance > 0
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
  GROUP BY r.start_station_name, r.end_station_name, r.avg_bike_duration
)
SELECT 
  start_station_name,
  end_station_name,
  avg_bike_duration,
  avg_taxi_duration
FROM taxi_matches
WHERE avg_bike_duration < avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
),
trip_with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) AS quantile_group
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  quantile_group,
  ROUND(MIN(trip_seconds / 60.0)) AS min_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(trip_seconds / 60.0)) AS max_duration_minutes,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  AVG(fare) AS avg_fare
FROM trip_with_quantile
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY quantile_group

SELECT 
    zct.census_tract_geoid,
    ROUND(AVG(inc.transaction_amt), 2) as avg_donation,
    ct.median_income
FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` inc
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` zct
    ON LEFT(inc.zip_code, 5) = zct.zip_code
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zip_to_county` zc
    ON LEFT(inc.zip_code, 5) = zc.zip_code
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` ct
    ON zct.census_tract_geoid = ct.geo_id
WHERE inc.state = 'NY' 
    AND zc.county_geoid = '36047'
    AND inc.transaction_amt IS NOT NULL
    AND inc.transaction_amt > 0
GROUP BY zct.census_tract_geoid, ct.median_income
ORDER BY zct.census_tract_geoid

WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    p.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 0)) as total_subplot_acres,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 0)) as total_macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
  WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
max_condition_per_group AS (
  SELECT 
    evaluation_group,
    evaluation_group_description,
    evaluation_type,
    evaluation_description,
    state_code,
    condition_status_code,
    total_subplot_acres,
    total_macroplot_acres,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT 
  evaluation_group_description as evaluation_group,
  evaluation_type,
  CAST(condition_status_code AS STRING) as condition_status_code,
  evaluation_description,
  SAFE_CAST(state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
  total_macroplot_acres as macroplot_acres,
  total_subplot_acres as subplot_acres
FROM max_condition_per_group
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH under20 AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    country_name,
    SUM(population_age_0 + population_age_1 + population_age_2 + population_age_3 + population_age_4 
       + population_age_5 + population_age_6 + population_age_7 + population_age_8 + population_age_9
       + population_age_10 + population_age_11 + population_age_12 + population_age_13 + population_age_14
       + population_age_15 + population_age_16 + population_age_17 + population_age_18 + population_age_19) AS pop_under_20
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_age_sex`
  WHERE year = 2020
  GROUP BY country_code, country_name
)
SELECT 
  u.country_name,
  u.pop_under_20,
  m.midyear_population,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(u.pop_under_20, m.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under_20
FROM under20 u
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population` m
  ON u.country_code = m.country_code AND m.year = 2020
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  country_name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) * 100, 2) AS recovery_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
WHERE date = '2020-05-10'
  AND aggregation_level = 0
  AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000
  AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL
  AND SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) <= 1
ORDER BY recovery_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH rochester_data AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) AS date,
    SAFE_CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) AS temp_f,
    SAFE_CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) AS prcp_in,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp_knots
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290'
  AND year = '2019' 
  AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
),
daily_values AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    ROUND((temp_f - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp_in * 2.54, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(wdsp_knots * 0.514444, 1) AS wind_speed_ms
  FROM rochester_data
  WHERE temp_f IS NOT NULL AND temp_f != 9999.9
    AND prcp_in IS NOT NULL AND prcp_in != 99.99
    AND wdsp_knots IS NOT NULL AND wdsp_knots != 999.9
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wind_speed_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wind_speed_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wind_ma8
  FROM daily_values
)
SELECT 
  date,
  temp_c,
  prcp_cm,
  wind_speed_ms,
  temp_ma8,
  prcp_ma8,
  wind_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag1_temp,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag2_temp,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag3_temp,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag4_temp,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag5_temp,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag6_temp,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag7_temp,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag8_temp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag1_prcp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag2_prcp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag3_prcp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag4_prcp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag5_prcp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag6_prcp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag7_prcp,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag8_prcp,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag1_wind,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag2_wind,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag3_wind,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag4_wind,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag5_wind,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag6_wind,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag7_wind,
  ROUND(wind_ma8 - LAG(wind_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS diff_lag8_wind
FROM with_ma
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date

WITH storm_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    season,
    basin,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    iso_time,
    usa_status,
    ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude) AS geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA'
),
consecutive_distances AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude),
      LEAD(ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude)) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time)
    ) AS dist_meters
  FROM storm_tracks
),
total_distances AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    SUM(dist_meters) AS total_distance_meters
  FROM consecutive_distances
  WHERE dist_meters IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sid, name
),
ranked_storms AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    total_distance_meters,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC) AS rank
  FROM total_distances
),
second_storm AS (
  SELECT sid, name
  FROM ranked_storms
  WHERE rank = 2
),
final_coords AS (
  SELECT st.sid, st.name, st.latitude, st.longitude, st.iso_time, st.usa_status
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` st
  JOIN second_storm s ON st.sid = s.sid
  WHERE st.season = '2020' AND st.basin = 'NA'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY st.sid ORDER BY st.iso_time DESC) = 1
)
SELECT fc.latitude, fc.longitude, fc.iso_time, fc.usa_status, fc.name

SELECT id, name
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations`
WHERE SQRT(POWER(latitude - 41.8319, 2) + POWER(longitude - (-87.6847), 2)) * 111.045 < 50

SELECT 
  t.bike_number,
  SUM(
    6371000 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POWER(SIN((es.latitude - ss.latitude) * 3.141592653589793 / 180 / 2), 2) +
      COS(ss.latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * COS(es.latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) *
      POWER(SIN((es.longitude - ss.longitude) * 3.141592653589793 / 180 / 2), 2)
    ))
  ) AS total_distance_meters

WITH same_station_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    end_station_id,
    starttime,
    LAG(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY start_station_id, end_station_id ORDER BY starttime) as prev_start,
    LEAD(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY start_station_id, end_station_id ORDER BY starttime) as next_start
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
marked AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    end_station_id,
    starttime,
    CASE WHEN 
      (prev_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(starttime, prev_start, SECOND) <= 120) OR
      (next_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(next_start, starttime, SECOND) <= 120)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as in_group
  FROM same_station_trips
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    SUM(in_group) as trips_in_groups
  FROM marked
  WHERE in_group = 1
  GROUP BY 1
),
total_ending AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id as station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips_ending
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.name, CAST(gs.start_station_id AS STRING)) as station_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(gs.trips_in_groups, te.total_trips_ending) as proportion
FROM group_counts gs
JOIN total_ending te ON gs.start_station_id = te.station_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` s ON CAST(gs.start_station_id AS STRING) = s.station_id
ORDER BY proportion DESC

WITH all_trips AS (

)
SELECT 
  pz.zone_name as pickup_zone,
  dz.zone_name as dropoff_zone,
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) as trip_duration_seconds,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(trip_distance, TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) / 3600.0) as speed_mph,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) * 100.0 as tip_rate_pct,
  total_amount
FROM all_trips t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pz ON t.pickup_location_id = pz.zone_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` dz ON t.dropoff_location_id = dz.zone_id
WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND dropoff_datetime <= '2016-07-07 23:59:59'
  AND passenger_count > 5
  AND trip_distance >= 10
  AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
  AND fare_amount >= 0
  AND tip_amount >= 0
  AND tolls_amount >= 0
  AND mta_tax >= 0
  AND total_amount >= 0
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Final query with the complete result
WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    tz.borough as pickup_borough,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.total_amount = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100
    END as tip_rate_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01' 
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2016-01-08'
    AND tz.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
),
categorized AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    tip_rate_pct,
    CASE 
      WHEN tip_rate_pct = 0 THEN 'no tip'
      WHEN tip_rate_pct <= 5 THEN 'Less than 5%'
      WHEN tip_rate_pct > 5 AND tip_rate_pct <= 10 THEN '5% to 10%'
      WHEN tip_rate_pct > 10 AND tip_rate_pct <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%'
      WHEN tip_rate_pct > 15 AND tip_rate_pct <= 20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN tip_rate_pct > 20 AND tip_rate_pct <= 25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      WHEN tip_rate_pct > 25 THEN 'More than 25%'
    END as tip_category
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  pickup_borough,
  tip_category,
  trip_count,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(trip_count, SUM(trip_count) OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_borough)), 4) as proportion
FROM (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    tip_category,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM categorized
  GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category
)
ORDER BY pickup_borough, 
  CASE tip_category
    WHEN 'no tip' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Less than 5%' THEN 2
    WHEN '5% to 10%' THEN 3
    WHEN '10% to 15%' THEN 4
    WHEN '15% to 20%' THEN 5
    WHEN '20% to 25%' THEN 6
    WHEN 'More than 25%' THEN 7
  END

WITH new_users AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM u.creation_date) = 2021
),
users_asked AS (
  SELECT 
    u.id as user_id,
    u.creation_date as signup_date,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM u.creation_date) as signup_month,
    MIN(q.creation_date) as first_question_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
    ON u.id = q.owner_user_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM u.creation_date) = 2021
    AND q.creation_date BETWEEN u.creation_date AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.creation_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY u.id, u.creation_date
),
users_answered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uq.user_id
  FROM users_asked uq
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
    ON uq.user_id = a.owner_user_id
  WHERE a.creation_date > uq.first_question_date
    AND a.creation_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(uq.first_question_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
)
SELECT 
  nu.signup_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT nu.user_id) as total_new_users,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT uq.user_id), COUNT(DISTINCT nu.user_id)) * 100, 2) as pct_asked,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT ua.user_id), COUNT(DISTINCT uq.user_id)) * 100, 2) as pct_answered
FROM new_users nu
LEFT JOIN users_asked uq
  ON nu.user_id = uq.user_id
LEFT JOIN users_answered ua
  ON uq.user_id = ua.user_id
GROUP BY nu.signup_month
ORDER BY nu.signup_month

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2010`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY date

),
complaint_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(created_date AS DATE) as date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2017
  GROUP BY date, complaint_type
),
total_by_date AS (
  SELECT date, SUM(cnt) as total_cnt
  FROM complaint_counts
  GROUP BY date
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    dt.date,
    dt.avg_temp,
    cc.complaint_type,
    cc.cnt as daily_complaints,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(cc.cnt, tb.total_cnt) * 100 as pct_total
  FROM daily_temp dt
  JOIN complaint_counts cc ON dt.date = cc.date
  JOIN total_by_date tb ON dt.date = tb.date
),
corr_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    j.complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as num_days,
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.daily_complaints) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.daily_complaints)) 
      / NULLIF(SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.avg_temp) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.avg_temp))
        * (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.daily_complaints * j.daily_complaints) - SUM(j.daily_complaints) * SUM(j.daily_complaints))), 0) as corr_temp_complaints,
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.pct_total) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.pct_total))
      / NULLIF(SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.avg_temp) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.avg_temp))
        * (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.pct_total * j.pct_total) - SUM(j.pct_total) * SUM(j.pct_total))), 0) as corr_temp_pct
  FROM joined j
  GROUP BY j.complaint_type
),
complaint_totals_all AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, COUNT(*) as total_complaints
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2008 AND 2017
  GROUP BY complaint_type
)
SELECT 
  cc.complaint_type,
  ct.total_complaints,
  cc.num_days,
  ROUND(cc.corr_temp_complaints, 4) as corr_temp_complaints,
  ROUND(cc.corr_temp_pct, 4) as corr_temp_pct
FROM corr_calc cc
JOIN complaint_totals_all ct ON cc.complaint_type = ct.complaint_type
WHERE ct.total_complaints > 5000
  AND (ABS(cc.corr_temp_complaints) > 0.5 OR ABS(cc.corr_temp_pct) > 0.5)
ORDER BY cc.complaint_type

-- Full query with Pearson correlation
WITH weather AS (
  SELECT 
    CONCAT(year, '-', LPAD(mo, 2, '0'), '-', LPAD(da, 2, '0')) as date_str,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as wdsp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE stn = '744860' 
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
    AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) IS NOT NULL
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    COUNT(*) as total_complaints
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date)
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(created_date) as complaint_date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as complaint_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
complaint_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type
  FROM daily_complaints
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(complaint_count) > 3000
),
daily_data AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.complaint_type,
    w.date_str as date_str,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.complaint_count, dt.total_complaints) as proportion,
    w.wdsp as wind_speed
  FROM daily_complaints dc
  JOIN daily_totals dt ON dc.complaint_date = dt.complaint_date
  JOIN complaint_totals ct ON dc.complaint_type = ct.complaint_type
  JOIN weather w ON CAST(dc.complaint_date AS STRING) = w.date_str
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    AVG(proportion) as avg_prop,
    AVG(wind_speed) as avg_wind,
    AVG(proportion * wind_speed) as avg_xy,
    AVG(proportion * proportion) as avg_x2,
    AVG(wind_speed * wind_speed) as avg_y2
  FROM daily_data
  GROUP BY complaint_type
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  n,
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      avg_xy - avg_prop * avg_wind,
      SQRT((avg_x2 - avg_prop * avg_prop) * (avg_y2 - avg_wind * avg_wind))
    ),
    4
  ) as pearson_correlation
FROM stats
ORDER BY pearson_correlation DESC

  COALESCE(a.total_1995, 0) AS total_1995,

  COALESCE(a.alive_1995, 0) AS alive_1995,
  COALESCE(b.alive_2015, 0) AS alive_2015,
  COALESCE(a.dead_1995, 0) AS dead_1995,
  COALESCE(b.dead_2015, 0) AS dead_2015,
  COALESCE(b.total_2015, 0) - COALESCE(a.total_1995, 0) AS total_growth,
  COALESCE(b.alive_2015, 0) - COALESCE(a.alive_1995, 0) AS alive_growth,
  COALESCE(b.dead_2015, 0) - COALESCE(a.dead_1995, 0) AS dead_growth
FROM y1995 a
FULL OUTER JOIN y2015 b ON a.spc_latin = b.spc_latin
ORDER BY total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10

    AND t.end_station_latitude IS NOT NULL

WITH tract_zip_overlap AS (
    SELECT 
        t.geo_id,
        z.zip_code,
        ST_AREA(t.tract_geom) as tract_total_area,
        ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) as overlap_area
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` t
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z 
        ON ST_INTERSECTS(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)
    WHERE ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) > 0
),
allocated AS (
    SELECT 
        o.zip_code,
        c.total_pop,
        c.income_per_capita,
        o.tract_total_area,
        o.overlap_area,
        c.total_pop * (o.overlap_area / o.tract_total_area) as allocated_pop,
        c.income_per_capita * c.total_pop * (o.overlap_area / o.tract_total_area) as allocated_income
    FROM tract_zip_overlap o
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr` c
        ON o.geo_id = c.geo_id
),
zip_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        zip_code,
        SUM(allocated_pop) as total_allocated_pop,
        SUM(allocated_income) as total_allocated_income,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(allocated_income), SUM(allocated_pop)) as avg_individual_income
    FROM allocated
    GROUP BY zip_code
)
SELECT 
    zt.zip_code,
    ROUND(zt.total_allocated_pop, 0) as total_population,
    ROUND(zt.avg_individual_income, 1) as avg_individual_income
FROM zip_totals zt
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON zt.zip_code = z.zip_code
WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
    z.internal_point_geom, 
    ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833), 
    5 * 1609.344
  )
ORDER BY avg_individual_income DESC

WITH natality AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SUM(Births) AS total_births,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_Desc = 'None checked' THEN Births ELSE 0 END) AS no_morbidity_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE Year BETWEEN DATE('2016-01-01') AND DATE('2018-01-01')
  GROUP BY birth_year, County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
census_2015 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
),
census_2016 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
),
census_2017 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) AS poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    n.birth_year,
    n.County_of_Residence_FIPS AS geo_id,
    CASE n.birth_year
      WHEN 2016 THEN c2015.poverty_rate
      WHEN 2017 THEN c2016.poverty_rate
      WHEN 2018 THEN c2017.poverty_rate
    END AS poverty_rate,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(n.no_morbidity_births, n.total_births) * 100 AS pct_no_morbidity
  FROM natality n
  LEFT JOIN census_2015 c2015 ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c2015.geo_id
  LEFT JOIN census_2016 c2016 ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c2016.geo_id
  LEFT JOIN census_2017 c2017 ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c2017.geo_id
  WHERE n.birth_year IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
    AND (n.birth_year = 2016 AND c2015.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL)
    OR (n.birth_year = 2017 AND c2016.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL)
    OR (n.birth_year = 2018 AND c2017.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL)
),
corr_data AS (
  SELECT 
    birth_year,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(poverty_rate) as sum_x,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y,
    SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_xy,
    SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) as sum_x2,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y2
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY birth_year
)
SELECT 
  birth_year AS year,
  n,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y))
  ) AS pearson_correlation
FROM corr_data
ORDER BY birth_year

WITH accident_persons AS (
    SELECT 
        a.state_number,
        a.consecutive_number,
        a.day_of_week,
        a.hour_of_crash,
        a.number_of_drunk_drivers,
        a.work_zone,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_number) as num_distinct_persons,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as num_fatal_injuries
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2016` p 
        ON a.state_number = p.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = p.consecutive_number
    GROUP BY a.state_number, a.consecutive_number, a.day_of_week, a.hour_of_crash, a.number_of_drunk_drivers, a.work_zone
),
accident_vehicles AS (
    SELECT 
        v.state_number,
        v.consecutive_number,
        v.body_type,
        CASE 
            WHEN v.travel_speed NOT IN (997, 998, 999) 
                 AND v.speed_limit NOT IN (98, 99)
            THEN ABS(CAST(v.travel_speed AS FLOAT64) - CAST(v.speed_limit AS FLOAT64))
            ELSE NULL
        END as speed_diff
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016` v
),
accident_features AS (
    SELECT 
        ap.state_number,
        ap.consecutive_number,
        ap.num_distinct_persons,
        ap.num_fatal_injuries,
        CASE WHEN ap.num_fatal_injuries > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as label,
        ap.day_of_week,
        ap.hour_of_crash,
        ap.number_of_drunk_drivers,
        CASE WHEN ap.work_zone != 'None' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as work_zone_indicator,
        ANY_VALUE(av.body_type) as body_type,
        AVG(av.speed_diff) as avg_speed_diff
    FROM accident_persons ap
    JOIN accident_vehicles av 
        ON ap.state_number = av.state_number AND ap.consecutive_number = av.consecutive_number
    WHERE ap.num_distinct_persons > 1
    GROUP BY ap.state_number, ap.consecutive_number, ap.day_of_week, ap.hour_of_crash, ap.number_of_drunk_drivers, ap.num_distinct_persons, ap.num_fatal_injuries, ap.work_zone
)
SELECT 
    label,
    state_number,
    body_type,
    number_of_drunk_drivers,
    day_of_week,
    hour_of_crash,
    work_zone_indicator,
    avg_speed_diff,
    CASE 
        WHEN avg_speed_diff IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN avg_speed_diff < 20 THEN 0
        WHEN avg_speed_diff < 40 THEN 1
        WHEN avg_speed_diff < 60 THEN 2
        WHEN avg_speed_diff < 80 THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END as speed_diff_level
FROM accident_features

-- Build the final query to find the state with highest timberland and forestland acres
WITH latest_eval AS (
    SELECT 
        peg.state_code,
        peg.evaluation_group_sequence_number,
        peg.evaluation_group,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY peg.state_code ORDER BY peg.evaluation_group DESC) as rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population_evaluation_group` peg
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population_evaluation_type` pet 
        ON peg.evaluation_group_sequence_number = pet.evaluation_group_sequence_number
    WHERE pet.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
latest_eval_only AS (
    SELECT state_code, evaluation_group_sequence_number, evaluation_group
    FROM latest_eval
    WHERE rn = 1
),
pop_condition AS (
    SELECT 
        p.state_code,
        p.evaluation_group_sequence_number,
        p.evaluation_group,
        c.condition_status_code,
        c.reserved_status_code,
        c.site_productivity_class_code,
        c.proportion_basis,
        c.condition_proportion_unadjusted,
        p.expansion_factor,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
            WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
            ELSE NULL
        END as adj_factor
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
        ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number
    JOIN latest_eval_only le
        ON p.evaluation_group_sequence_number = le.evaluation_group_sequence_number
        AND p.state_code = le.state_code
    WHERE p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
-- Timberland acres per state
timberland_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        evaluation_group,
        SUM(expansion_factor * adj_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted) as total_acres
    FROM pop_condition
    WHERE condition_status_code = 1
        AND reserved_status_code = 0
        AND site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6
        AND adj_factor IS NOT NULL
        AND adj_factor > 0
    GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group
),
-- Forestland acres per state
forestland_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        state_code,
        evaluation_group,
        SUM(expansion_factor * adj_factor * condition_proportion_unadjusted) as total_acres
    FROM pop_condition
    WHERE condition_status_code = 1
        AND adj_factor IS NOT NULL
        AND adj_factor > 0
    GROUP BY state_code, evaluation_group
),
-- Get the state with highest timberland acres
timberland_best AS (
    SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, total_acres,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_acres DESC) as rn
    FROM timberland_acres
),
forestland_best AS (
    SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, total_acres,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_acres DESC) as rn
    FROM forestland_acres
),
-- Get state names from plot table
state_names AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT state_code, MAX(state_code_name) as state_code_name
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition`
    GROUP BY state_code
)
-- Combine results
SELECT 
    'timberland' as category,
    tb.state_code,
    tb.evaluation_group,
    sn.state_code_name as state_name,
    tb.total_acres
FROM timberland_best tb
JOIN state_names sn ON tb.state_code = sn.state_code
WHERE tb.rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'forestland' as category,
    fl.state_code,
    fl.evaluation_group,
    sn.state_code_name as state_name,
    fl.total_acres
FROM forestland_best fl
JOIN state_names sn ON fl.state_code = sn.state_code
WHERE fl.rn = 1

WITH covid_cases AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1`,

WITH mitelman_cases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
),
cyto_freq AS (
  SELECT c.Chr, 
         SUM(CASE WHEN c.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as gain_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN c.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as loss_count
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c
  JOIN mitelman_cases mc ON c.RefNo = mc.RefNo AND c.CaseNo = mc.CaseNo
  GROUP BY c.Chr
),
recurrent_gains AS (
  SELECT 
    'chr' || REPLACE(Abnormality, '+', '') as Chr,
    SUM(CAST(TotalCases AS INT64)) as gain_total
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentNumData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401' AND Abnormality LIKE '+%'
  GROUP BY Chr
),
recurrent_losses AS (
  SELECT 
    'chr' || REPLACE(Abnormality, '-', '') as Chr,
    SUM(CAST(TotalCases AS INT64)) as loss_total
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentNumData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401' AND Abnormality LIKE '-%'
  GROUP BY Chr
),
gain_data AS (
  SELECT c.Chr, c.gain_count, g.gain_total
  FROM cyto_freq c
  JOIN recurrent_gains g ON c.Chr = g.Chr
  WHERE c.gain_count >= 5 AND g.gain_total >= 5
),
loss_data AS (
  SELECT c.Chr, c.loss_count, l.loss_total
  FROM cyto_freq c
  JOIN recurrent_losses l ON c.Chr = l.Chr
  WHERE c.loss_count >= 5 AND l.loss_total >= 5
),
gain_corr AS (
  SELECT 
    'Gain' as aberration_type,
    CORR(gain_count, gain_total) as correlation_coefficient,
    COUNT(*) as num_records
  FROM gain_data
),
loss_corr AS (
  SELECT 
    'Loss' as aberration_type,
    CORR(loss_count, loss_total) as correlation_coefficient,
    COUNT(*) as num_records
  FROM loss_data
)
SELECT * FROM gain_corr
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM loss_corr

WITH storm_tracks AS (

  WHERE basin = 'NA' AND season = '2020' AND track_type = 'main'
    AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL
),
segment_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    season,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    point_num,
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude, latitude),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(LAG(longitude) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time), LAG(latitude) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time))
    ) as segment_dist_m
  FROM storm_tracks
)
SELECT 
  sid,
  name,
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  usa_wind,
  point_num,
  COALESCE(segment_dist_m, 0) as segment_dist_m,
  SUM(COALESCE(segment_dist_m, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cumulative_dist_m,
  SUM(COALESCE(segment_dist_m, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / 1000 as cumulative_dist_km

-- Compute average correlation per sample type, filtering out |corr| > 0.5
WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT 
    a.sample_type,
    p.gene_symbol,
    p.protein_abundance_log2ratio AS protein,
    LOG(r.fpkm_unstranded + 1) AS expression
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.quant_proteome_CPTAC_CCRCC_discovery_study_pdc_current` p
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.PDC_metadata.aliquot_to_case_mapping_current` a
    ON p.aliquot_id = a.aliquot_id
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.RNAseq_hg38_gdc_current` r
    ON a.sample_submitter_id = r.sample_barcode
    AND p.gene_symbol = r.gene_name
    AND a.sample_type = r.sample_type_name
  WHERE a.sample_type IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
    AND r.primary_site = 'Kidney'
    AND p.protein_abundance_log2ratio IS NOT NULL
    AND r.fpkm_unstranded IS NOT NULL
    AND r.fpkm_unstranded + 1 > 0
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT 
    sample_type,
    gene_symbol,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(protein) AS sum_x,
    SUM(expression) AS sum_y,
    SUM(protein * expression) AS sum_xy,
    SUM(protein * protein) AS sum_x2,
    SUM(expression * expression) AS sum_y2
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY sample_type, gene_symbol
),
filtered_corrs AS (
  SELECT 
    sample_type,
    gene_symbol,
    (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) * 1.0 / 
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y)) AS pearson_corr
  FROM correlations
  WHERE n > 2
    AND (n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) > 0
    AND (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y) > 0
)
SELECT 
  sample_type,
  AVG(pearson_corr) AS avg_correlation
FROM filtered_corrs
WHERE ABS(pearson_corr) <= 0.5
GROUP BY sample_type

WITH contingency AS (
  WITH kras_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode 
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` 
    WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS'
  ),
  tp53_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode 
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` 
    WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53'
  ),
  all_paad_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode 
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` 
    WHERE Study = 'PAAD'
  )
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN k.ParticipantBarcode IS NOT NULL AND t.ParticipantBarcode IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a,
    SUM(CASE WHEN k.ParticipantBarcode IS NOT NULL AND t.ParticipantBarcode IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as b,
    SUM(CASE WHEN k.ParticipantBarcode IS NULL AND t.ParticipantBarcode IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN k.ParticipantBarcode IS NULL AND t.ParticipantBarcode IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as d,
    COUNT(*) as n
  FROM all_paad_patients p
  LEFT JOIN kras_patients k ON p.ParticipantBarcode = k.ParticipantBarcode
  LEFT JOIN tp53_patients t ON p.ParticipantBarcode = t.ParticipantBarcode
)
SELECT 
  a, b, c, d, n,
  -- Row totals
  (a+b) as row1_total,
  (c+d) as row2_total,
  -- Column totals
  (a+c) as col1_total,
  (b+d) as col2_total,
  -- Expected values: E_ij = (row_i_total * col_j_total) / n
  SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(a+c), n) as e_a,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(b+d), n) as e_b,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(a+c), n) as e_c,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(b+d), n) as e_d,
  -- Chi-squared using sum of (O-E)^2/E
  SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(a - SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(a+c), n), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(a+c), n)) +
  SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(b - SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(b+d), n), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(b+d), n)) +
  SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(c - SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(a+c), n), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(a+c), n)) +
  SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(d - SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(b+d), n), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(b+d), n)) as chi_squared
FROM contingency

-- Final query with all four categories
-- Using CytoBands_hg38 to define chromosomal bands
-- Mapping "Gain" to "gains" and "Loss" to "losses"
-- "amplifications" and "homozygous_deletions" are 0
-- Frequency is calculated as percentage of total events per band, rounded to 2 decimals

SELECT 
    cb.chromosome,
    cb.cytoband_name,
    cb.hg38_start as band_start,
    cb.hg38_stop as band_end,
    0 as amplifications,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as gains,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as losses,
    0 as homozygous_deletions,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 
                SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100, 2) as gain_freq,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 
                SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100, 2) as loss_freq
FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoBands_hg38` cb
LEFT JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` cc
  ON cb.chromosome = cc.Chr
  AND cc.Start >= cb.hg38_start
  AND cc.Start < cb.hg38_stop
LEFT JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` cg 
  ON cc.RefNo = cg.RefNo AND cc.CaseNo = cg.CaseNo
WHERE cg.Morph = '3111' OR cg.Topo = '0401'
GROUP BY cb.chromosome, cb.cytoband_name, cb.hg38_start, cb.hg38_stop
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Gain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN cc.Type = 'Loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY cb.chromosome, cb.hg38_start, cb.hg38_stop

WITH chr13_loss AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Chr, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted
  WHERE Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start < 48481890 AND `End` > 48303751
),
chr17_loss AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Chr, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted
  WHERE Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start < 7687490 AND `End` > 7668421
),
chr11_gain AS (
  SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone, Chr, ChrOrd, Start, `End`
  FROM mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted
  WHERE Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain' AND Start < 108369102 AND `End` > 108223067
),
matching_clones AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c13.RefNo, c13.CaseNo, c13.InvNo, c13.Clone
  FROM chr13_loss c13
  JOIN chr17_loss c17 ON c13.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c17.Clone
  JOIN chr11_gain c11 ON c13.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND c13.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND c13.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND c13.Clone = c11.Clone
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  mc.RefNo AS CaseReference,
  mc.CaseNo,
  mc.InvNo AS InvestigationNumber,
  mc.Clone,
  c13.ChrOrd AS Chr13_ChrOrd,
  c13.Start AS Chr13_Start,
  c13.`End` AS Chr13_End,
  c17.ChrOrd AS Chr17_ChrOrd,
  c17.Start AS Chr17_Start,
  c17.`End` AS Chr17_End,
  c11.ChrOrd AS Chr11_ChrOrd,
  c11.Start AS Chr11_Start,
  c11.`End` AS Chr11_End,
  kc.CloneShort AS KaryotypeShort
FROM matching_clones mc
JOIN chr13_loss c13 ON mc.RefNo = c13.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c13.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c13.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c13.Clone
JOIN chr17_loss c17 ON mc.RefNo = c17.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c17.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c17.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c17.Clone
JOIN chr11_gain c11 ON mc.RefNo = c11.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c11.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c11.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c11.Clone
JOIN mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone kc ON mc.RefNo = kc.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = kc.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = kc.InvNo AND mc.Clone = kc.CloneNo

-- The question says "out of all available stations in the NOAA GSOD database"
-- The GSOD database contains the daily weather observations. "Available stations" 
-- in the context of this question likely means stations that have data in gsod2022.
-- 
-- But let me also consider: the question could mean stations in the stations table
-- that have valid USAF codes. Let me re-read: "What percentage of weather stations 
-- recorded valid temperature data... out of all available stations in the NOAA GSOD database"
-- 
-- "All available stations in the NOAA GSOD database" = all stations in gsod2022 with valid USAF codes
-- That's 12103 stations.
-- 12075 met the criteria.
-- Percentage = 12075/12103 * 100 = 99.76865240023135

-- Let me do one final verification query to make sure everything is correct
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN valid_days * 1.0 / total_days >= 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM (
  SELECT stn, 
         COUNT(*) as total_days,
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
                  AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
                  AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
  WHERE stn != '999999'
  GROUP BY stn
)

WITH monthly_stats AS (

  -- First trip duration (earliest start_date)
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN duration_min END) as first_trip_duration_min,
  -- Last trip duration (latest start_date)
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN duration_min END) as last_trip_duration_min,
  -- Highest trip duration
  MAX(duration_min) as highest_trip_duration_min,
  -- Lowest trip duration
  MIN(duration_min) as lowest_trip_duration_min
FROM monthly_stats
GROUP BY year_month
ORDER BY year_month

WITH season_max AS (

),
peak_teams AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons` s
  JOIN season_max sm ON s.season = sm.season
  WHERE s.season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
    AND s.name IS NOT NULL AND s.name != ''
    AND s.wins = sm.max_wins
)
SELECT name, COUNT(*) as peak_seasons
FROM peak_teams

WITH top_2021 AS (
  SELECT 
    category_name,
    AVG(sale_dollars / volume_sold_liters) AS avg_per_liter_2021
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2021
    AND volume_sold_liters > 0
  GROUP BY category_name
  ORDER BY avg_per_liter_2021 DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
category_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    s.category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) AS yr,
    AVG(s.sale_dollars / s.volume_sold_liters) AS avg_per_liter
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales` s
  WHERE s.volume_sold_liters > 0
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
  GROUP BY s.category_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date)
)
SELECT 
  t.category_name,
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.yr = 2019 THEN c.avg_per_liter END) AS avg_per_liter_2019,
  MAX(CASE WHEN c.yr = 2020 THEN c.avg_per_liter END) AS avg_per_liter_2020,
  t.avg_per_liter_2021
FROM top_2021 t
JOIN category_avgs c ON t.category_name = c.category_name
GROUP BY t.category_name, t.avg_per_liter_2021
ORDER BY t.avg_per_liter_2021 DESC

WITH all_games AS (
  SELECT gameId, seasonType, homeTeamId, homeTeamName, awayTeamId, awayTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_wide`
  WHERE seasonType = 'REG' AND pitchSpeed > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gameId, seasonType, homeTeamId, homeTeamName, awayTeamId, awayTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`
  WHERE seasonType = 'PST' AND pitchSpeed > 0
),
lineups AS (
  SELECT gameId, lineupTeamId, lineupPlayerId, homeTeamId, awayTeamId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_wide`
  WHERE lineupTeamId != '' AND lineupPlayerId != ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gameId, lineupTeamId, lineupPlayerId, homeTeamId, awayTeamId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`
  WHERE lineupTeamId != '' AND lineupPlayerId != ''
),
pitcher_teams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ag.gameId, ag.pitcherId, ag.pitcherFirstName, ag.pitcherLastName, ag.pitchSpeed, ag.homeTeamId, ag.homeTeamName, ag.awayTeamId, ag.awayTeamName,
    CASE 
      WHEN l.lineupTeamId = ag.homeTeamId THEN ag.homeTeamId
      WHEN l.lineupTeamId = ag.awayTeamId THEN ag.awayTeamId
      ELSE NULL
    END AS confirmedTeamId,
    CASE 
      WHEN l.lineupTeamId = ag.homeTeamId THEN ag.homeTeamName
      WHEN l.lineupTeamId = ag.awayTeamId THEN ag.awayTeamName
      ELSE NULL
    END AS confirmedTeamName
  FROM all_games ag
  LEFT JOIN lineups l ON ag.gameId = l.gameId AND ag.pitcherId = l.lineupPlayerId
),
team_pitcher_speeds AS (
  SELECT confirmedTeamId, confirmedTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName,
    MAX(pitchSpeed) AS max_speed
  FROM pitcher_teams
  WHERE confirmedTeamId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY confirmedTeamId, confirmedTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT confirmedTeamId, confirmedTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_speed,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY confirmedTeamId ORDER BY max_speed DESC) AS rn
  FROM team_pitcher_speeds
)
SELECT confirmedTeamId, confirmedTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_speed
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY confirmedTeamName

WITH station_counts AS (

),
entrance_counts AS (

),
ada_station_counts AS (

  WHERE stations_with_ada_entry > 0

)
SELECT

WITH yearly_sales AS (

  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) IN (2022, 2023)
    AND sale_dollars > 0
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT 
    item_number,
    item_description,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2022 THEN total_revenue END) AS revenue_2022,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2023 THEN total_revenue END) AS revenue_2023
  FROM yearly_sales
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description
  HAVING revenue_2022 > 0 AND revenue_2023 > 0
)
SELECT 
  item_number,
  item_description,
  revenue_2022,
  revenue_2023,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(revenue_2023 - revenue_2022, revenue_2022) * 100 AS yoy_growth_pct

WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        c.inventory_year,
        c.state_code,
        c.proportion_basis,
        p.expansion_factor,
        c.condition_proportion_unadjusted,
        p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot,
        p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 
            THEN p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
            ELSE 0
        END as subplot_size,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 
            THEN p.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
            ELSE 0
        END as macroplot_size
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
        ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
        AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
        AND c.state_code = p.state_code
    WHERE c.inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
        AND c.condition_status_code = 1
        AND p.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
subplot_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        inventory_year,
        state_code,
        AVG(subplot_size) as avg_subplot_size
    FROM base
    WHERE proportion_basis = 'SUBP'
    GROUP BY inventory_year, state_code
),
macroplot_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        inventory_year,
        state_code,
        AVG(macroplot_size) as avg_macroplot_size
    FROM base
    WHERE proportion_basis = 'MACR'
    GROUP BY inventory_year, state_code
),
subplot_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        'subplot' as plot_type,
        inventory_year,
        state_code,
        avg_subplot_size as avg_size,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_subplot_size DESC) as rn
    FROM subplot_avg
),
macroplot_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        'macroplot' as plot_type,
        inventory_year,
        state_code,
        avg_macroplot_size as avg_size,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inventory_year ORDER BY avg_macroplot_size DESC) as rn
    FROM macroplot_avg
)
SELECT plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, avg_size
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM subplot_ranked WHERE rn = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM macroplot_ranked WHERE rn = 1
)
ORDER BY plot_type, inventory_year

WITH top5_2008 AS (

category_shares AS (

WITH user_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) AS first_visit_date,
    MAX(date) AS last_visit_date,
    MIN(CASE WHEN totals.transactions IS NOT NULL AND totals.transactions > 0 THEN date END) AS first_transaction_date,
    ARRAY_AGG(device.isMobile ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS last_visit_isMobile
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_txn AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    ARRAY_AGG(device.isMobile ORDER BY date ASC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS first_txn_isMobile
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL AND totals.transactions > 0
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
user_combined AS (
  SELECT 
    us.fullVisitorId,
    us.first_visit_date,
    us.last_visit_date,
    us.first_transaction_date,
    us.last_visit_isMobile,
    ft.first_txn_isMobile,
    CASE 
      WHEN us.last_visit_isMobile = TRUE THEN TRUE
      WHEN us.first_transaction_date IS NOT NULL AND us.last_visit_date = us.first_transaction_date AND ft.first_txn_isMobile = TRUE THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS last_event_isMobile
  FROM user_stats us
  LEFT JOIN first_txn ft ON us.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
)
SELECT 
  MAX(DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', last_visit_date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_visit_date), DAY)) AS max_days
FROM user_combined
WHERE last_event_isMobile = TRUE

WITH filtered_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    totals.pageviews,
    totals.transactions,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170601' AND '20170731'
    AND totals.pageviews IS NOT NULL
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    month,
    pageviews,
    CASE WHEN transactions IS NOT NULL AND transactions > 0 THEN 'purchase' ELSE 'non_purchase' END as classification
  FROM filtered_sessions
),
visitor_month_class AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    month,
    classification,
    SUM(pageviews) as total_pageviews
  FROM classified
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, month, classification
),
averages AS (
  SELECT
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', month) as month,
    classification,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(total_pageviews), COUNT(*)) as avg_pageviews
  FROM visitor_month_class
  GROUP BY month, classification
)
SELECT
  month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'purchase' THEN avg_pageviews END) as avg_pageviews_purchase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'non_purchase' THEN avg_pageviews END) as avg_pageviews_non_purchase
FROM averages
GROUP BY month

SELECT
  FORMAT_DATE('%B %Y', month_start) AS month,
  ROUND(add_to_cart_rate, 2) AS add_to_cart_conversion_rate,
  ROUND(purchase_conversion_rate, 2) AS purchase_conversion_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month_start,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS add_to_cart_rate,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS purchase_conversion_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170331'
    AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type IN ('2', '3', '6')
  GROUP BY month_start
)
ORDER BY month_start

WITH first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_transaction_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
transaction_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    s.date as transaction_date,
    s.device.deviceCategory
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  ft.fullVisitorId as visitorId
FROM first_transaction ft
JOIN transaction_sessions ts 
  ON ft.fullVisitorId = ts.fullVisitorId 
  AND ft.first_transaction_date = ts.transaction_date
JOIN first_visit fv ON ft.fullVisitorId = fv.fullVisitorId
WHERE ts.deviceCategory = 'mobile'
  AND ft.first_transaction_date > fv.first_visit_date
ORDER BY ft.fullVisitorId

-- Final query: Find the port with most storm appearances
SELECT p.port_name
FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_international_ports.world_port_index` p
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.states` s
  ON ST_WITHIN(p.port_geom, s.state_geom)
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` h
  ON ST_DWITHIN(p.port_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(h.longitude, h.latitude), 
       GREATEST(COALESCE(h.usa_r34_ne, 0), COALESCE(h.usa_r34_se, 0), COALESCE(h.usa_r34_sw, 0), COALESCE(h.usa_r34_nw, 0)) * 1852)
WHERE p.region_number = '6585' 
  AND h.basin = 'NA' 
  AND h.name != 'NOT_NAMED' 
  AND h.wmo_wind >= 35
  AND GREATEST(COALESCE(h.usa_r34_ne, 0), COALESCE(h.usa_r34_se, 0), COALESCE(h.usa_r34_sw, 0), COALESCE(h.usa_r34_nw, 0)) > 0
GROUP BY p.port_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH all_stations AS (

stations_2013 AS (

),
stations_2014 AS (

WITH daily_country_temps AS (
  SELECT

  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
  WHERE g.mo = '10'
    AND g.date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-10-31'
    AND s.country IN ('US', 'UK')
    AND g.max != 9999.9
    AND g.min != 9999.9
    AND g.temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY s.country, g.date
),
us_temps AS (
  SELECT date, avg_max as us_max, avg_min as us_min, avg_temp as us_avg
  FROM daily_country_temps
  WHERE country = 'US'
),
uk_temps AS (
  SELECT date, avg_max as uk_max, avg_min as uk_min, avg_temp as uk_avg
  FROM daily_country_temps
  WHERE country = 'UK'
)
SELECT 
  us.date,
  ROUND(us.us_max - uk.uk_max, 1) as max_temp_diff,
  ROUND(us.us_min - uk.uk_min, 1) as min_temp_diff,
  ROUND(us.us_avg - uk.uk_avg, 1) as avg_temp_diff
FROM us_temps us
JOIN uk_temps uk ON us.date = uk.date
ORDER BY us.date

WITH trip_zip AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) AS hour_of_day,
    t.pickup_datetime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2015-01-01' AND t.pickup_datetime < '2015-01-02'
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_longitude != 0 AND t.pickup_latitude != 0
),
zip_hour_counts AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM trip_zip
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour_of_day
),
all_zip_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT zip_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
),
all_hours AS (
  SELECT hour FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 23)) AS hour
),
cross_join AS (
  SELECT zc.zip_code, h.hour
  FROM all_zip_codes zc
  CROSS JOIN all_hours h
),
full_grid AS (
  SELECT cj.zip_code, cj.hour, COALESCE(thc.trip_count, 0) as trip_count
  FROM cross_join cj
  LEFT JOIN zip_hour_counts thc 
    ON cj.zip_code = thc.zip_code AND cj.hour = thc.hour_of_day
),
-- For lag metrics: since we only have Jan 1 data, look back within Jan 1 data
-- 1 hour ago: same zip_code, hour-1 (on Jan 1)
-- 24 hours ago: same zip_code, same hour, day-1 (Dec 31 - no data)
-- 168 hours ago: same zip_code, same hour, day-7 (Dec 25 - no data)
-- 336 hours ago: same zip_code, same hour, day-14 (Dec 18 - no data)
lag_1hr AS (
  SELECT fh.zip_code, fh.hour,
    COALESCE(CASE WHEN fh.hour > 0 THEN (SELECT thc2.trip_count FROM zip_hour_counts thc2 
      WHERE thc2.zip_code = fh.zip_code AND thc2.hour_of_day = fh.hour - 1) ELSE 0 END, 0) as lag_1hr
  FROM full_grid fh
),
-- Moving averages: 14-day and 21-day excluding current hour
-- Since no data before Jan 1, these will be 0
moving_averages AS (
  SELECT fh.zip_code, fh.hour, fh.trip_count,
    0.0 as moving_avg_14day,
    0.0 as moving_avg_21day,
    0.0 as moving_std_14day,
    0.0 as moving_std_21day,
    l1.lag_1hr as lag_1hr,
    0 as lag_24hr,
    0 as lag_168hr,
    0 as lag_336hr
  FROM full_grid fh
  JOIN lag_1hr l1 ON fh.zip_code = l1.zip_code AND fh.hour = l1.hour
)
SELECT zip_code, hour, trip_count,
  lag_1hr, lag_24hr, lag_168hr, lag_336hr,
  moving_avg_14day, moving_avg_21day,
  moving_std_14day, moving_std_21day
FROM moving_averages
ORDER BY trip_count DESC
LIMIT 5

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q

),
answer_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    question_id,
    SUM(answer_score) AS total_score
  FROM question_answers
  GROUP BY question_id
),
ranked_with_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    qa.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY qa.question_id ORDER BY qa.answer_score DESC, qa.answer_id ASC) AS rank_by_score,
    ast.total_score
  FROM question_answers qa
  JOIN answer_stats ast ON qa.question_id = ast.question_id
),
associated_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id AS question_id, owner_user_id AS user_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
  WHERE owner_user_id IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION DISTINCT
  
  SELECT DISTINCT question_id, answer_owner AS user_id
  FROM ranked_with_stats
  WHERE answer_owner IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      answer_id = accepted_answer_id
      OR answer_score > 5
      OR (answer_score > 0 AND answer_score > 0.2 * total_score)
      OR rank_by_score <= 3

),

        b.zip_code,

        AVG(b.total_banks * o.overlap_ratio) as concentration
    FROM zip_bg_overlap o
    JOIN banks_by_zip b ON o.zip_code = b.zip_code
    GROUP BY b.zip_code, b.total_banks
)
SELECT zip_code, concentration
FROM zip_concentration
ORDER BY concentration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH tract_data AS (

        t2011.geo_id,
        t2011.total_pop AS pop_2011,
        t2018.total_pop AS pop_2018,
        t2011.median_income AS income_2011,
        t2018.median_income AS income_2018,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(t2018.total_pop - t2011.total_pop, t2011.total_pop) * 100 AS pop_pct_increase,
        t2018.median_income - t2011.median_income AS income_abs_increase
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr` t2011
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` t2018

    WHERE t2011.geo_id LIKE '36047%'

),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        geo_id, pop_2011, pop_2018, income_2011, income_2018,
        pop_pct_increase, income_abs_increase,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pop_pct_increase DESC) AS pop_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY income_abs_increase DESC) AS income_rank
    FROM tract_data
)
SELECT geo_id, pop_rank, income_rank, pop_pct_increase, income_abs_increase, pop_2011, pop_2011, income_2011, income_2018

WITH monthly_diff AS (

),
pivoted AS (

  FROM monthly_diff

),
all_months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6
  UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
)
SELECT 
  am.month,

  COALESCE(p.subscriber_minutes, 0) AS subscriber_minutes,

condition_counts AS (

  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.condition_occurrence` co

WITH station_filter AS (

with_lag AS (

  FROM monthly_counts

company_max_increase AS (

  FROM with_lag
  WHERE increase IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY company

ranked AS (

-- Now format the output as requested:
-- - Time range formatted as "XXm to XXm" with zero-padded two digits
-- - Total trips count
-- - Average fare rounded to 2 decimal places
-- - Sort chronologically by time range (by min_minute)

WITH distinct_minutes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT SAFE_CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) as minute_val
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds IS NOT NULL 
    AND SAFE_CAST(trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) BETWEEN 1 AND 50
),
minute_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    minute_val,
    NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY minute_val) as quantile_group
  FROM distinct_minutes
),
trip_quantiles AS (
  SELECT 
    mg.quantile_group,
    SAFE_CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) as minute_val,
    t.fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips` t
  JOIN minute_groups mg ON SAFE_CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) = mg.minute_val
  WHERE t.trip_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE_CAST(t.trip_seconds / 60 AS INT64) BETWEEN 1 AND 50
)
SELECT 
  CONCAT(LPAD(CAST(MIN(minute_val) AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm to ', LPAD(CAST(MAX(minute_val) AS STRING), 2, '0'), 'm') as time_range,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  ROUND(AVG(fare), 2) as avg_fare
FROM trip_quantiles
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY MIN(minute_val)

  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.object_id) >= 500

WITH living_A_patients AS (
  SELECT p.id as patient_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p
  WHERE (SELECT n.family FROM UNNEST(p.name) n LIMIT 1) LIKE 'A%'
    AND (p.deceased IS NULL OR p.deceased.boolean = FALSE)
),
patients_with_one_condition AS (
  SELECT c.subject.patientId as patient_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) as condition_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
  WHERE c.subject.patientId IN (SELECT patient_id FROM living_A_patients)
  GROUP BY c.subject.patientId
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) = 1
),
patient_conditions AS (
  SELECT c.subject.patientId as patient_id,
         c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as condition_code,
         c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as condition_display
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
  WHERE c.subject.patientId IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patients_with_one_condition)
),
patient_active_meds AS (
  SELECT mr.subject.patientId as patient_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) as active_med_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr
  WHERE mr.status = 'active'
    AND mr.subject.patientId IN (SELECT patient_id FROM patients_with_one_condition)
  GROUP BY mr.subject.patientId
)
SELECT pc.condition_code,
       pc.condition_display,
       MAX(COALESCE(pam.active_med_count, 0)) as max_active_meds
FROM patient_conditions pc
LEFT JOIN patient_active_meds pam ON pc.patient_id = pam.patient_id
GROUP BY pc.condition_code, pc.condition_display

  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014
  UNION ALL

  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014

  WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014

averages AS (

WITH sorafenib_targets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe.stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
  WHERE pe.uniprot_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
    LEFT JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
    WHERE i.drugID = 157
      AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
      AND (e.exp_assayValueMedian IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL OR e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100)
  )
),
all_pe_tas AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pe_stable_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77`
  WHERE evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
pathways AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.stable_id, p.name
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p
  JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pp ON p.stable_id = pp.pathway_stable_id
  WHERE p.lowest_level = TRUE
    AND pp.evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
pathway_targets AS (
  SELECT pp.pathway_stable_id, COUNT(DISTINCT st.stable_id) as targets_in
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pp
  JOIN sorafenib_targets st ON pp.pe_stable_id = st.stable_id
  WHERE pp.evidence_code = 'TAS'
  GROUP BY pp.pathway_stable_id
),
total_targets AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM sorafenib_targets
),
pathway_non_targets AS (
  SELECT pp.pathway_stable_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.pe_stable_id) as non_targets_in
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pp
  JOIN all_pe_tas ap ON pp.pe_stable_id = ap.pe_stable_id
  LEFT JOIN sorafenib_targets st ON ap.pe_stable_id = st.stable_id
  WHERE pp.evidence_code = 'TAS'
    AND st.stable_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY pp.pathway_stable_id
),
total_non_targets AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM all_pe_tas ap
  LEFT JOIN sorafenib_targets st ON ap.pe_stable_id = st.stable_id
  WHERE st.stable_id IS NULL
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    p.stable_id as pathway_id,
    p.name as pathway_name,
    COALESCE(pt.targets_in, 0) as targets_in,
    (SELECT total FROM total_targets) - COALESCE(pt.targets_in, 0) as targets_outside,
    COALESCE(pnt.non_targets_in, 0) as non_targets_in,
    (SELECT total FROM total_non_targets) - COALESCE(pnt.non_targets_in, 0) as non_targets_outside
  FROM pathways p
  LEFT JOIN pathway_targets pt ON p.stable_id = pt.pathway_stable_id
  LEFT JOIN pathway_non_targets pnt ON p.stable_id = pnt.pathway_stable_id
)
SELECT 
  pathway_id,
  pathway_name,
  targets_in,
  targets_outside,
  non_targets_in,
  non_targets_outside,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    (targets_in + targets_outside + non_targets_in + non_targets_outside) * 
    (targets_in * non_targets_outside - targets_outside * non_targets_in) * 
    (targets_in * non_targets_outside - targets_outside * non_targets_in),
    (targets_in + targets_outside) * (non_targets_in + non_targets_outside) * (targets_in + non_targets_in) * (targets_outside + non_targets_outside)
  ) as chi_squared
FROM contingency
WHERE (targets_in + targets_outside) > 0 
  AND (non_targets_in + non_targets_outside) > 0
  AND (targets_in + non_targets_in) > 0
  AND (targets_outside + non_targets_outside) > 0
ORDER BY chi_squared DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT 
        a.assay_id,
        a.standard_type,
        a.molregno,

        a.standard_value,

    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29` cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
    WHERE SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
        AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
