           SUM(CASE WHEN potential_duplicate = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dup_count
    FROM qualifying
    GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 5 AND SUM(CASE WHEN potential_duplicate = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 2
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT q.assay_id, q.standard_type, q.molregno, q.activity_id, q.standard_value, q.standard_relation, q.doc_id, q.heavy_atoms, q.canonical_smiles
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN mol_counts mc ON q.assay_id = mc.assay_id AND q.standard_type = mc.standard_type AND q.molregno = mc.molregno
),
-- Get publication dates for docs - pre-filter to relevant docs
relevant_docs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT doc_id FROM filtered
),
doc_with_dates AS (
    SELECT doc_id, journal, year, first_page,
           CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY journal, year ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64)) - 1 AS FLOAT64) 
           / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY journal, year) - 1, 0) AS FLOAT64) as pct_rank
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29`
    WHERE journal IS NOT NULL AND journal != '' AND doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM relevant_docs)
),
doc_dates AS (
    SELECT doc_id,
           COALESCE(
               CAST(year AS STRING) || '-' || LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(FLOOR(pct_rank * 11) + 1, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0') || '-' || LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(FLOOR(pct_rank * 308) AS INT64) - (SAFE_CAST(FLOOR(pct_rank * 308) AS INT64) / 28) * 28 + 1, 1) AS STRING), 2, '0'),
               '1970-01-01'
           ) as pub_date
    FROM doc_with_dates
),
-- Join filtered activities with doc dates
filtered_with_dates AS (
    SELECT f.*, d.pub_date
    FROM filtered f
    LEFT JOIN doc_dates d ON f.doc_id = d.doc_id
),
-- Get one representative activity per molregno per (assay_id, standard_type)
mol_rep AS (
    SELECT assay_id, standard_type, molregno,
           FIRST_VALUE(activity_id) OVER (PARTITION BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno ORDER BY activity_id) as rep_activity_id,
           FIRST_VALUE(canonical_smiles) OVER (PARTITION BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno ORDER BY activity_id) as rep_smiles,
           FIRST_VALUE(standard_value) OVER (PARTITION BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno ORDER BY activity_id) as rep_sv,
           FIRST_VALUE(doc_id) OVER (PARTITION BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno ORDER BY activity_id) as rep_doc_id,
           FIRST_VALUE(pub_date) OVER (PARTITION BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno ORDER BY activity_id) as rep_pub_date,
           FIRST_VALUE(heavy_atoms) OVER (PARTITION BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno ORDER BY activity_id) as rep_ha
    FROM filtered_with_dates
),
mol_rep_distinct AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT assay_id, standard_type, molregno, rep_activity_id, rep_smiles, rep_sv, rep_doc_id, rep_pub_date, rep_ha
    FROM mol_rep
),
-- Find pairs
pairs AS (
    SELECT f1.assay_id, f1.standard_type, f1.molregno as molregno_1, f2.molregno as molregno_2,
           f1.rep_activity_id as activity_id_1, f1.rep_sv as sv_1, f1.rep_doc_id as doc_id_1, f1.rep_ha as ha_1, f1.rep_smiles as smiles_1, f1.rep_pub_date as pub_date_1,
           f2.rep_activity_id as activity_id_2, f2.rep_sv as sv_2, f2.rep_doc_id as doc_id_2, f2.rep_ha as ha_2, f2.rep_smiles as smiles_2, f2.rep_pub_date as pub_date_2
    FROM mol_rep_distinct f1
    JOIN mol_rep_distinct f2 ON f1.assay_id = f2.assay_id 
        AND f1.standard_type = f2.standard_type 
        AND f1.molregno < f2.molregno
)
SELECT assay_id, standard_type, molregno_1, molregno_2,
       GREATEST(ha_1, ha_2) as max_heavy_atoms,
       GREATEST(pub_date_1, pub_date_2) as latest_pub_date,
       GREATEST(doc_id_1, doc_id_2) as highest_doc_id,
       CASE 
           WHEN SAFE_CAST(sv_1 AS FLOAT64) < SAFE_CAST(sv_2 AS FLOAT64) THEN 'increase'
           WHEN SAFE_CAST(sv_1 AS FLOAT64) > SAFE_CAST(sv_2 AS FLOAT64) THEN 'decrease'
           ELSE 'no-change'
       END as change_type,
       to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(activity_id_1, activity_id_2)))) as uuid_activity,
       to_hex(md5(to_json_string(struct(smiles_1, smiles_2)))) as uuid_smiles
FROM pairs
LIMIT 20

WITH events AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
channelized AS (
  SELECT 
    medium,
    source,
    campaign_name,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('(none)', '(not set)', '(direct)') AND LOWER(source) = '(direct)' THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN LOWER(campaign_name) LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign_name), '(?i)^.*(shop|shopping).*$'))
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), '(?i).*(cpc|ppc|retargeting|paid).*') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), '(?i).*(cpc|ppc|paid).*') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), '(?i).*(cpc|ppc|retargeting|paid).*') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), '(?i).*(cpc|ppc|retargeting|paid).*') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign_name), '(?i)^.*(shop|shopping).*$') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('badoo', 'facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'twitter', 'whatsapp')
        OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), '(?i).*video.*') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
        OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail')
        OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN LOWER(source) = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) LIKE '%push'
        OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%mobile%'
        OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%notification%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM events
),
channel_counts AS (
  SELECT channel, COUNT(*) as session_count
  FROM channelized
  GROUP BY channel
)

ORDER BY session_count DESC

    first_open_ts,
    MAX(CASE WHEN day_offset BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week1_retained,
    MAX(CASE WHEN day_offset BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week2_retained,
    MAX(CASE WHEN day_offset BETWEEN 15 AND 21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week3_retained
  FROM user_activity
  WHERE day_offset IS NOT NULL AND day_offset >= 0 AND day_offset <= 21
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, first_open_ts
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week1_retained), COUNT(*)) as week_1_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week2_retained), COUNT(*)) as week_2_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week3_retained), COUNT(*)) as week_3_retention_rate
FROM retention_flags

-- Final query with proper rounding
WITH first_openers AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, MIN(event_date) as first_open_date, MIN(event_timestamp) as first_open_ts
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003' AND event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING first_open_date BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20180930'
),
removers AS (
  SELECT e.user_pseudo_id, e.event_date as remove_date, e.event_timestamp as remove_ts
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
  INNER JOIN first_openers fo ON e.user_pseudo_id = fo.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003' AND e.event_name = 'app_remove'
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT fo.user_pseudo_id, fo.first_open_date, r.remove_date,
    DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', r.remove_date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fo.first_open_date), DAY) as days_to_remove
  FROM first_openers fo
  INNER JOIN removers r ON fo.user_pseudo_id = r.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', r.remove_date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fo.first_open_date), DAY) BETWEEN 0 AND 7
),
crashes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
  INNER JOIN qualified q ON e.user_pseudo_id = q.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181003' AND e.event_name = 'app_exception'
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_pseudo_id), COUNT(DISTINCT q.user_pseudo_id)) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM qualified q
LEFT JOIN crashes c ON q.user_pseudo_id = c.user_pseudo_id

WITH 
-- Step 1: Find first event date for each user
first_events AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_date) as first_event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181002'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
-- Step 2: Identify cohort users (first session in week of July 2, 2018)
cohort AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id
  FROM first_events
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_event_date), WEEK(MONDAY)) = DATE '2018-07-02'
),
-- Step 3: Get all events for cohort users and map to weeks
user_week_activity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    e.user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date), WEEK(MONDAY)) as activity_week
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
  WHERE e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180612' AND '20181002'
  AND e.user_pseudo_id IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM cohort)
),
-- Step 4: Calculate week offset and aggregate
retention AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_DIFF(activity_week, DATE '2018-07-02', WEEK) as week_offset
  FROM user_week_activity
),
-- Step 5: Count retained users per week
weekly_retention AS (
  SELECT 
    week_offset,
    COUNT(user_pseudo_id) as retained_users
  FROM retention
  WHERE week_offset BETWEEN 0 AND 4
  GROUP BY week_offset
),
-- Step 6: Get cohort size
cohort_size AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_new_users FROM cohort
)
SELECT 
  CONCAT('Week ', wr.week_offset) as week_identifier,
  cs.total_new_users as new_users,
  wr.retained_users
FROM weekly_retention wr
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs
ORDER BY wr.week_offset

WITH session_starts AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id ORDER BY event_date) as rn
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003' AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
first_sessions AS (

  FROM session_starts
  WHERE rn = 1
),
cohort_assigned AS (
  SELECT 
    fs.user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fs.first_session_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fs.first_session_date)) - 1) DAY) as cohort_monday
  FROM first_sessions fs
  WHERE DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fs.first_session_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', fs.first_session_date)) - 1) DAY) >= '2018-07-02'
),
cohort_sizes AS (
  SELECT cohort_monday, COUNT(*) as total_users
  FROM cohort_assigned
  GROUP BY cohort_monday
)
SELECT cohort_monday, total_users FROM cohort_sizes ORDER BY cohort_monday

WITH page_views AS (

  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
),
home_sessions AS (

  FROM page_views
  WHERE page_title = 'Home'
),
both_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ga_session_id
  FROM page_views
  WHERE page_title IN ('Home', 'Checkout Confirmation')
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT page_title) = 2
)

FROM home_sessions home

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') AS page_title,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128`
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
    AND user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
),
with_parts AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    page_title,
    page_location,
    SPLIT(page_location, '/') AS url_parts,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) AS np
  FROM base
),
with_display AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    page_title,
    page_location,
    url_parts,
    np,
    CASE 
      WHEN np >= 5 THEN
        CASE 
          WHEN LOWER(url_parts[OFFSET(np - 1)]) LIKE '%+%' THEN 'PDP'
          ELSE 'PLP'
        END
      ELSE page_title
    END AS display_title
  FROM with_parts
),
with_rn AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    display_title,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn
  FROM with_display
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT display_title, rn,
    LAG(display_title) OVER (ORDER BY rn) AS prev_title
  FROM with_rn
),
deduped AS (
  SELECT display_title, rn
  FROM with_prev
  WHERE prev_title IS NULL OR display_title != prev_title
)
SELECT 
  '1362228.4966015575' AS user_pseudo_id,
  STRING_AGG(display_title, '>>' ORDER BY rn) AS navigation_flow
FROM deduped
